maidgap.gui.pickup_tip: Click to cycle. Terminal clicks take this many items; the maid also moves at most this many per source slot each cycle. Stored on the gap, applies live
maidgap.gui.refill_tip: For YOU (the player): when on, items in your inventory at or below the threshold (default 8) are automatically topped up to a full stack every 2 seconds from bound containers; even items used up completely (0 left) get a fresh stack pulled back. Binding sources include gaps you carry AND gaps worn in YOUR OWN maid's bauble slot within 96 blocks - no need to take the gap off her. Note: you must be near the container (same dimension, within bind range) for refills to work; up to 3 item types per scan. Tune threshold/interval in maid_gap_enhanced-common.toml

maidgap.gui.filter_mode_tip: Click to switch whitelist/blacklist. Every container has its own filter: while it shows 'shared', you are editing the list shared by all containers.
maidgap.gui.scope_tip: 'shared' = every container uses the same filter; 'own' = this container only uses its own filter. Switching to 'own' for the first time copies the current list; switching back to 'shared' only archives it (nothing is deleted) - switching to 'own' again restores it as it was. To send different items into different chests, set each chest to 'own' and edit its list.
